title: AGENT_MESSAGE envelope (inter-agent communication)
description: Standard envelope for any message that crosses an agent boundary in NIZAM. Used by SHURA -> NAQD delegation, MARSAD -> Tariq briefs, Hayat -> Salman annotations, the coordinator -> any agent, etc. Carries trace_id end-to-end so a single user turn can be reconstructed across multiple LLM calls. Every field is required unless marked optional.

trace_id.description: Stable per user turn. Persists across hops so the chain summary can reconstruct the full agent path.

message_id.description: Unique per envelope. Enables idempotent re-delivery.

parent_message_id.description: Set on every hop after the first; null on the operator-originated turn.

from_agent.description: Codename: Operator, Ammar, Amin, Salman, Hazim, Tariq, Khalid, Khaldun, Tahir, Hayat, Sadiq.

to_agent.description: Codename of the recipient agent or 'Operator' for an outbound reply.

delegation_depth.description: 0 = operator turn. Each agent->agent hop increments by 1. Hops <= 3 auto-permitted; >3 forces needs_operator_confirm=true. Hard cap 8 (defense in depth).

kind.description: request: ask for output. delegation: route to another specialist. annotation: side-channel addition (e.g., Hayat -> Salman). challenge: NAQD red-team. synthesis: Khaldun weekly. alert: SUKOON/HIMAYAH gate event. operator_reply: outbound Telegram.

purpose.description: Single sentence: WHY this message exists. Used by NAQD when arbitrating conflicts.

privacy_class.description: Most-sensitive tier of any field in payload. Coordinator MUST enforce against egress_class.

egress_class.description: Tightest egress the envelope is permitted to traverse. Strict_local may be zdr_inference_only or operator_only.

payload.description: Free-form per agent contract. Each agent defines its own payload sub-schema; the envelope only requires that the payload is a JSON object.

context_refs.description: Anti-hallucination: every claim the sender makes should ideally cite a context_ref. NAQD enforces this when challenging.

confidence.description: Sender's own confidence in payload. Used by NAQD threshold (default 0.15 spread between alternatives triggers arbitration).

alternatives.description: Optional ranked alternatives. NAQD reads these when arbitrating.

needs_operator_confirm.description: Coordinator sets true when (a) delegation_depth>3, (b) privacy_class >= strict_local AND first egress, (c) cost guardrail crosses soft ceiling. Operator-in-the-loop checkpoint (E1.4).

operator_confirm_reason.description: When needs_operator_confirm=true, the coordinator explains why in one sentence.

cost_cents.description: Estimated LLM cost in cents for this hop, when known. Aggregated by cost_ceiling.

model.description: Concrete model used (e.g., 'deepseek-v4-pro', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'local-llama-3b', 'local-deterministic'). Null for purely deterministic hops.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls this hop made, by name. args_hash is sha256 of canonicalized args (no plaintext stored).
